lines.junior: Yi Jun asks: "Watchers walk past my door. Did one see you knock?"
lines.master: Yi Jun asks: "Watchers walk past my door. Did one see you knock?"

lines.rookie: The 6:40 walk takes ten minutes. We knocked at 6:50, when it had passed.
lines.junior: The 6:40 walk takes ten minutes. We knocked at 6:50, when it had passed.
lines.master: The 6:40 walk takes ten minutes. We knocked at 6:50, just after it passed.

lines.rookie: Next walk: 7:20. No one saw you.
lines.junior: The next walk is at 7:20. No one saw you.
lines.master: The next walk is not until 7:20. No one saw you.

lines.rookie: That does not show when you knocked.
lines.junior: That does not show when you knocked.
lines.master: That does not explain when you knocked.

lines.rookie: Which card has the watchers' times?
lines.junior: Which card has the watchers' times on it?
lines.master: Which card shows the watchers' times? Look again.

lines.rookie: GIVE YI JUN THE LETTER
lines.junior: GIVE YI JUN THE LETTER
lines.master: GIVE YI JUN THE LETTER

lines.rookie: No watcher saw it. Not anywhere.
lines.junior: No watcher saw it. Not anywhere at all.
lines.master: No watcher saw it: not at the pine, gate or door.
